List recordings (filter by type, project_id, assigned_to)

parameters.name: assigned_to
parameters.description: User id — restricts to Todo recordings assigned to that user. Combined with a `type` other than Todo, the request is contradictory and returns 422 (assigned_to_todo_only).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination: skip that many recordings (newest first). Pages are 100 long — iterate offset += 100 until a page comes back shorter than 100.

post.summary: Create a recording of any recordable type

parameters.name: completion_watcher_ids
parameters.description: Todo only — users notified every time the to-do is completed. Silently bounded to the project members.

parameters.name: recurrence
parameters.description: Todo only — makes the to-do a recurring SERIES and creates its first instance. Ignored without a due_on (the anchor). Pair with recurrence_until / recurrence_config.

requestBody.description: Upload only — the file itself, sent as multipart/form-data alongside the query parameters. Required for type=Upload (422 file_required otherwise); ignored for every other type. Without a title, the recording is named after the uploaded filename. Set parent_id to a Vault to file it there, or to a Document to attach it inside that document.

get.summary: Show a recording

patch.summary: Update a recording (title, body, due_on) and complete/reopen a Todo

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Rich-text body, when the recordable has one

parameters.name: due_on
parameters.description: Todo and Card; send an empty value to clear it

parameters.name: completed
parameters.description: Todo only — goes through the model's completion mechanics (records the activity event and the completer). On any other recordable type: 422 (completed_todo_only).

parameters.name: completion_watcher_ids
parameters.description: Todo only — REPLACES the list of users notified on completion (send an empty array to clear it). Silently bounded to the project members.

parameters.name: recurrence
parameters.description: Todo only — sets or changes the recurrence rule (future unfinished instances are regenerated). Send "none" to stop the series: future unfinished instances are trashed and the to-do becomes standalone. Refused implicitly on an instance (the schedule belongs to the series).
